sourceQuote: Certificate of Chinese language education Applicants who want to be enrolled as a sophomore or junior in Chinese Language majors shall submit the certificate of full-time Chinese training and academic record in original or notarized copy in English or Chinese
targetQuote: 中文教育证书 拟以大二或大三学生身份入读汉语言专业的申请人，应提交全日制中文培训证明及中英文原件或经公证的副本成绩记录
